propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1,000,000 input-token windows, making sonnet-to-opus escalation a no-op rung that gains zero additional context capacity.

Context-limit retry escalation to opus fails silently and self-confirmingly at opus pricing after a second full round-trip, with the failure misdiagnosed as a true capacity limit rather than a redundant escalation.

Both declared window figures (haiku 200k, sonnet 1M, opus 1M) are verified correct against the provider's live Models API max_input_tokens field, so the defect is in escalation consumption logic, not the table contents.

New escalation_rungs() function filters models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the previous kept rung, while leaving models_at_or_above() and MODEL_LADDER unchanged for provider stickiness and size-budget observability.

Both context-limit escalation loops (pass1_with_ladder and prerequisites.run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to prevent the guaranteed-failing paid call at identical context limits.
